# The Android Journey

This part uses the demo app **minapp** (`re.frida.minapp`, label `FridaMin`).
The app has a license gate, a premium flag, a coin balance, and a hidden
secret. The prebuilt APK is at <https://t.me/rzfrida/25>.

```{mermaid}
mindmap
  root((minapp))
    secret.SecretVault
      getSecret
      checkSecret
      nativeCheckSecret
    license.LicenseChecker
      VALID_KEY
    game.GameState
      premium
      coins
      buyPremium
      addCoins
    MainActivity
      Activate License
      Upgrade to Premium
      Earn Coins
      Load Plugin
    dynamic.DynamicClass
    libnative.so
      g_secret
```
